data.notes: September 2026 is especially strong for Mexican Independence Day-adjacent Latin programming, alongside major Strip residencies and arena-scale festival dates.

events.title: iHeartRadio Music Festival
events.summary: T-Mobile Arena confirms the iHeartRadio Music Festival for Friday, September 18 and Saturday, September 19, 2026. The annual two-night festival is one of Las Vegas’ marquee multi-genre pop events.

events.title: Carín León at Sphere
events.summary: Carín León’s Sphere run is listed for September 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, and 13, 2026. The limited engagement brings regional Mexican music into one of Las Vegas’ highest-profile immersive venues.

events.title: Eagles Live at Sphere
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists Eagles Live at Sphere performances on September 18 and 19, 2026, at Sphere in Las Vegas. The dates extend the band’s long-running immersive Sphere residency.

events.title: Marc Anthony: Vegas… My Way!
events.venueName: BleauLive Theater at Fontainebleau Las Vegas
events.summary: Fontainebleau lists newly added Marc Anthony residency dates on September 11, 12, 13, 16, 18, and 19, 2026. The show is described as a first-of-its-kind intimate residency featuring English- and Spanish-language hits from across his career.

events.title: MANÁ: Vivir Sin Aire Tour
events.summary: MANÁ’s Vivir Sin Aire Tour is confirmed at T-Mobile Arena on Friday, September 11, 2026. The show anchors Mexican Independence Day weekend with one of Latin rock’s biggest legacy acts.

events.title: Scorpions: Coming Home to Las Vegas
events.venueName: PH Live at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino
events.summary: Caesars confirms Scorpions’ new PH Live residency from September 17 through October 3, 2026, with special guest Buckcherry. The run celebrates the band’s 60-plus-year career and follows prior sold-out Las Vegas residencies.

events.title: Sammy Hagar: The Best of All Worlds Las Vegas Residency
events.summary: MGM lists Sammy Hagar’s September 2026 Dolby Live residency dates as September 18, 19, 23, 25, and 26. The Best of All Worlds show features Hagar with Michael Anthony, Joe Satriani, Kenny Aronoff, and Rai Thistlethwayte.

events.title: High Stakes Festival 2026
events.summary: Two-night electronic festival at AREA15 with a 2026 lineup including ACRAZE, NGHTMRE, JOYRYDE, Getter, Ship Wrek, Wuki, Softest Hard and more.

events.title: Dom Dolla at LIV Beach
events.venueName: LIV Beach at Fontainebleau Las Vegas
events.summary: LIV lists Dom Dolla for a 2026 residency season across LIV Nightclub and LIV Beach, including a Saturday, September 5, 2026 LIV Beach date. Expect house-focused pool-party programming from the Australian DJ and producer.

events.title: City of Lights Las Vegas Soul Festival
events.summary: The Las Vegas Soul Fest site confirms the festival for September 26 and 27, 2026. Produced by the team behind the City of Lights Las Vegas Jazz Festival, it is positioned around R&B and soul programming at Clark County Government Amphitheater.

events.title: Matute: Disco Stereo Tour
events.summary: The Venetian confirms Matute’s Disco Stereo Tour for September 11 and 12, 2026, at 8:30 p.m. The Mexican group’s Las Vegas weekend is billed around its high-energy live treatment of ’80s Spanish- and English-language hits.

events.title: RL Grime at Zouk Nightclub
events.summary: Zouk resident-date for RL Grime, anchoring the bass/trap side of Las Vegas’s large-format club programming in September.

events.title: World of Warcraft: 20 Years of Music
events.summary: Resorts World confirms World of Warcraft: 20 Years of Music for September 19 and 20, 2026, at Resorts World Theatre. The production features a full symphonic orchestra and choir performing music from across the game’s universe.

events.title: Alison Krauss & Union Station
events.venueName: Encore Theater at Wynn Las Vegas
events.summary: Wynn lists Alison Krauss & Union Station for Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at 8 p.m. at Encore Theater. The booking brings a respected roots and bluegrass ensemble to the Strip’s theater circuit.

events.title: WeTouchGrass presents: Anime Rave
events.summary: Touring anime-rave party brand brings a 21+ pop-culture/electronic club event to downtown Las Vegas’s SUBSTANCE.

events.title: MIYUKICORE Las Vegas
events.summary: MIYUKI’s debut headlining-tour stop billed as a high-energy night of techno, trance and live flute performance.

events.title: Lowkey in the Library — September Wednesdays
events.summary: Weekly Wednesday Library-room house series at Marquee, with September 2026 listings including DJ Hills, Close Friends Only, Chris Garcia and L’Core.

events.title: Drai’s After Hours: R&B Thursdays
events.summary: Recurring late-night R&B/hip-hop after-hours series from Drai’s, one of Las Vegas’s longest-running after-hours institutions.

events.title: Drai’s After Hours: House • Hip Hop Sundays
events.summary: Weekly Drai’s After Hours Sunday programming blending house and hip-hop in the club’s post-1am late-night format.

events.title: LIGHTWAVE C-Rave Experience
events.summary: Local 18+ warehouse-style rave focused on uplifting trance, melodic techno and bass house, billed as supporting the underground community.
